messages:
Iris Park: Quick report: the Next starter that wires LangChain + LlamaIndex occasionally shows duplicate generation calls when running SSR on edge providers. Noticed during onboarding demo.
Iris Park: Repro: deploy starter, open /ssr-search, single query => two telemetry hits.
Marco Silva: Which SDK and starter commit?
Iris Park: starter@v0.4.2, @redwood/inference-js@0.9.3. Logs show a fetch retry then SDK retry.
Iris Park: Snippet from server handler (edge):
```js
export const runtime = 'edge'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
// in route handler: await client.generate({ model: 'rw-llama-7b', prompt })
```
Marco Silva: Short term workaround: add an Idempotency-Key header per-request or disable sdk retry in server contexts.
Iris Park: I tried adding header uuid and the duplicate went away locally.
Team CI Bot: Created ticket: starter-templates#450 "Edge SSR double-call in LangChain starter" assigned to @Marco Silva
Marco Silva: I'll draft a tiny starter patch to set autoIdempotency for server runtimes and update README with a note. Also will propose JS SDK change to pin auth + auto-add idempotency for server contexts to match Python behavior.
Iris Park: Thanks — I'll update the onboarding doc to mention this caveat until the SDK change lands.
devex-bot: Noted.
